audit.why: 53.65% over 315 Emerald+ games, difficulty 6/10. Sett has no gap-closer, so the early nest is free; the lane only becomes a coin-flip once Facebreaker range (490) can reach you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with both the packet chart and its own why-text in four rows: whys[0] and whys[1] describe a dashless Sett walking into beams (Heimerdinger) but the chart read 'Skill'; whys[3] says 'pure execution on his grab versus your stun' (Skill) but the chart read 'Heimerdinger'; whys[6] says the front-loaded lead is the only thing keeping it even but the chart read 'Heimerdinger'.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Skill / Skill / Heimerdinger / Skill, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never used Sett's real ability names beyond Haymaker and mis-stated its own interactions. dosFull[0].d said only 'Shield + true damage' without the consequence; dontsFull[1].d ('Eat his W true damage') carried boilerplate about burning your own cooldown; phases[4].why described the ultimate vaguely.
audit.corrected: Haymaker (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s) banks the damage you deal Sett and returns true damage in the centre, so armour is the wrong buy and you must poke then leave. Facebreaker is 490 range and only stuns if enemies are on both sides of him — alone against a turret line it slows you instead. The Show Stopper is 120/100/80s, grounds, and carries a dashless yordle out of his own nest.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in report[8] and breakdown.late, which is right against a passive that scales regen off missing health.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sett's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Show Stopper (80-120s) carries you through the air and grounds — it locks a dashless yordle. Whoever lands CC first wins at 6.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Zone it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Haymaker shields and hits true — armour won't help. Bait it, then engage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His W banks the damage you deal him — poke, then step out of the smash.

notes: Packet defect 'never names any of Sett's abilities' applies to the full layer only — the content layer already names Pit Grit-style mechanics, Haymaker, Facebreaker and The Show Stopper correctly, so no content prose was touched. Deliberately did NOT write 'suppress' anywhere new: Riot's Show Stopper text says carries and slams, and suppression is not stated in the kit file (whys[4] and mid already say 'suppress' from a prior run — left alone rather than guessed at, flagged here). Facebreaker's stun-only-if-enemies-on-both-sides clause is worth surfacing on a future pass; it means a lone Heimerdinger is usually only slowed.
